title: Golf ball lands on Frederick Wolfe's grave
place_text: Fort Knox golf course cemetery, Kentucky

tellings.quote: And it says Frederick Wolfe. >> [sighs] >> German soldier died

plain: In 1976, on a golf course at Fort Knox in Kentucky that has a cemetery on it, a golf ball came down on a grave marked "Frederick Wolfe. German soldier died." A former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen tells Michels this as his own experience, reading the stone aloud on the show. He tells it in an episode where he describes himself as a time traveler, as one of the odd moments in his life.
